**Coaching note:**

When you see a forcing move like a check, calculate the full line before moving. Here, **Re1+** isn't just harassing the king—it sets up a mating attack. After Kh2, the follow-up **Bg3+** forces fxg3, and your f-pawn delivers checkmate. The key lesson: look for back-rank and king-safety weaknesses. Checks that activate your pieces while attacking the opponent's can lead to tactical cascades—calculate them all the way to mate!
